errors.text_span: с няколко минимума в 2005 г. (27 156) и 2009 г. (29 700)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies minima for the blue line (Bulgaria). The values 27,156 (for 2005) and 29,700 (for 2009) actually belong to the orange line (World), not the blue line. The correct values for Bulgaria in those years are 32,463 and 34,193 respectively, and they are not minima.

The description incorrectly states that the minimum for the green line (EC (28)) occurred in 2009. The value 76,402 is indeed a local minimum, but it is located at the year 2008 on the chart, not 2009.

The description incorrectly identifies the point for the red line (USA) in 2009 (104,668) as a minimum. The value in the preceding year, 2008, is lower (103,504), and the line is generally increasing in this period. Therefore, this point is not a minimum.
The description of the X-axis fails to mention that the labels for the years 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024 are marked with an asterisk (*), which is a distinct visual feature of the axis.
Calling the starting point of the series for Bulgaria a 'връх' (peak) is incorrect and confusing, as this point (25,064) is the absolute minimum value for that entire line.

While the starting point for the 'World' series is its minimum value, describing it as a 'minimum' in the context of trend analysis (which usually refers to local minima or 'dips') is confusing, especially when the line shows a consistent upward trend from that point.

errors.text_span: Всички линии са изобразени с равномерни интервали по оста X, като всеки етикет на оста X съответства на година, а всеки етикет на оста Y съответства на конкретна стойност на производителността на труда.
errors.evidence: This concluding sentence is redundant as it merely describes the basic functionality of a line chart, information that is already implicitly understood from the descriptions of the axes and lines. It does not add any new specific information about this particular figure.
